title: Physical hardware test run record
$comment: SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 ComradeArt — SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later. One record per test per device. NOT_PRESENT is a statement about the device, never a pass. A NOT_RUN row must carry NO observation fields: a row that claims it was not run while carrying a timestamp or evidence is either a mistake or a fabrication, and the schema refuses both rather than guessing which. A PASS must carry at least one evidence file, because a PASS with no artifact is an assertion, not a result — the same rule release/hardware.py enforces at intake.

testId.$comment: The fixed physical test list. Fixed so that a report cannot invent a flattering test, and so that every report answers the same questions; adding a test is an edit to this schema, which is a reviewable act.

result.$comment: PARTIAL means the feature worked with caveats that the notes must describe. NOT_PRESENT means the device lacks the hardware (no camera, no battery). NOT_SUPPORTED means the hardware exists but the OS cannot drive it. None of the three is a pass, and none of the three counts toward qualification.

observedAt.$comment: When the operator observed the result. Required for every result except NOT_RUN, and forbidden for NOT_RUN — nothing was observed.

operator.$comment: Who observed the result. Required for every result except NOT_RUN (Stage-26 adversarial rule 17: an observation without an observer is refused).

evidenceFiles.$comment: Files produced by the collectors or by the operator, each bound to its sha256 so a later edit to the artifact is detectable. An empty list is forbidden even where the field is optional: an empty claim of evidence is worse than no claim.

path.$comment: Relative to hardware/evidence/, matching the intake's substantiation check; absolute paths would leak usernames and are refused there anyway.

notes.$comment: Free text. Never the word certified or its family — release/hardware.py refuses it; the permitted vocabulary is tested, qualified for pilot, supported based on evidence.

allOf.$comment: The NOT_RUN rule, encoded with the not construction so a validator enforces the ABSENCE of the fields, not merely their optionality. If the row says NOT_RUN it must carry no observedAt and no evidenceFiles; if it says anything else it must name when and by whom. This is the single conversion this framework exists to prevent: NOT_RUN quietly dressed up as an observation.

A PASS must be substantiated: at least one evidence file (minItems 1 comes from the property definition). A page of PASS values with no artifacts is the fake-physical-report case and it fails here, before it ever reaches intake.
